sync_problem_address: No Vaultwarden answers at that address. Check it, then try again.
sync_problem_auth: The server didn’t accept the username or app password.
sync_problem_conflict: Another device kept changing the file. Kemlock will try again shortly.
sync_problem_folder: That folder doesn’t exist on the server. Create it first, then try again.
sync_problem_format: This folder has a file Kemlock can’t use for this. Choose another folder.
sync_problem_homeMissing: Kemlock’s note is gone from your Vaultwarden, so nothing was synced. Turn sync off, then on again.
sync_problem_insecure: Use an https:// address. Plain http would send your password unencrypted.
sync_problem_kemlockAddress: No Kemlock Server answers at that address. Check it, then try again.
sync_problem_kemlockOlder: The server handed back an older copy of your vault than this device already saw, or one that doesn’t match its signed list, so nothing was synced and nothing changed. Kemlock will try again. If this keeps happening, don’t trust that server until you know why.
sync_problem_key: That passphrase doesn’t open the sync file in this folder.
sync_problem_modeChanged: Another device changed how Vaultwarden keeps your codes, so nothing was synced.
sync_problem_network: Couldn’t reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
sync_problem_networkWeb: Couldn’t reach the server. In a browser, the server must also allow this site (CORS); the iOS and Android apps don’t need that.
sync_problem_older: The server gave back an older copy of the sync file than this device already synced, so nothing was synced: entries deleted since would have come back. Kemlock will try again. If you put an older copy back yourself, set this sync up again on this device.
sync_problem_removals: This sync would remove many entries, so it waits for you.
sync_problem_server: The server reported an error. Try again later.
sync_problem_sessionEnded: Kemlock Server ended this device’s session, as it does when you sign out from another device. Sign in again; your entries are kept.
sync_problem_sessionReused: Kemlock Server ended this session for safety: a sign-in token was used twice, which can mean it was copied. Sign in again; your entries are kept.
sync_problem_signedOut: Your Vaultwarden session ended, as it does after a password change. Sign in again.
sync_problem_spaceCantBeChecked: A shared space on Kemlock Server can’t be checked: its chain of changes goes back, forks or isn’t signed by who it should be. Nothing of it was synced, and the rest of your vault was. Kemlock will try again.
sync_problem_spaceKeysPending: A shared space on Kemlock Server is waiting for its keys to be replaced, so nothing of it was synced yet, and the rest of your vault was. Kemlock will try again after an Owner or Admin has replaced them.
sync_problem_unsupported: This Vaultwarden account uses something Kemlock can’t do yet.
